title: perf(types): defer pydantic schema builds via shared LiteLLMBaseModel
body:
## TLDR

Problem this solves:

- Every LiteLLM pydantic model builds its schema at import time
- Proxy import pays for ~1,380 schema builds, most never used

How it solves it:

- New shared base `LiteLLMBaseModel` sets `defer_build` from `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD`
- `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD` defaults to true; `"true"`, `"1"`, `"on"` enable it
- All direct `BaseModel` subclasses in `litellm/` and `enterprise/` now inherit it
- Trace codegen passes `--base-class` so regenerated models stay on it

```python
# litellm/constants.py
DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD: Final = os.getenv("DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD", "true") in ("true", "1", "on")

# litellm/types/llms/base.py
class LiteLLMBaseModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(defer_build=DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD)

class LiteLLMPydanticObjectBase(LiteLLMBaseModel): ...      # keeps its dict-returning .json()
class BaseLiteLLMOpenAIResponseObject(LiteLLMBaseModel): ...
```

The parsing matches the OpenAI and Anthropic SDKs, which already read this same variable, so `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD=false` turns eager builds back on everywhere at once. `LiteLLMPydanticObjectBase` was not used as the universal base because its `.json()` returns a dict, which would change behavior for ~1,300 classes

Instances that a parent model's validator creates, or that come from `model_construct`, never run their own class's first-use build, so the class keeps pydantic's `MockValSer` and a later `serialize_as_any` or `Any`-typed dump of that instance fails. `LiteLLMBaseModel.model_post_init` rebuilds an incomplete class the first time any instance of it appears, which is a single attribute check once the class is built. This is open upstream as https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/issues/13647, so the hook carries a TODO to drop it once pydantic ships the fix

The lens worker image copies a handful of `litellm/proxy/lens/` modules into a standalone package without `litellm` installed, so `models.py`, `worker.py` and `agent_context.py` stay on plain `pydantic.BaseModel`

Pydantic merges `model_config` from parents, so subclasses that set their own `model_config` keep `defer_build` unless they override that key. Moving mutable defaults on migrated models to `Field(default=...)` / `PrivateAttr(default=...)` and dict `model_config` to `ConfigDict(...)` keeps the strict ruff `RUF012` budget flat; pydantic already copied those defaults per instance, so behavior is unchanged

## User Flow

Before: an operator starting the proxy waits on ~1,380 pydantic schema builds before it can serve

1. They run `litellm --config config.yaml`
2. The proxy module import takes ~9.9s and ~534 MB RSS before the server starts
3. Requests to POST http://localhost:4000/v1/chat/completions succeed once it is up

After: the same proxy starts faster with less memory and serves the same responses

1. They run `litellm --config config.yaml` with no new settings
2. The proxy module import takes ~8.9s and ~510 MB RSS before the server starts
3. Requests to POST http://localhost:4000/v1/chat/completions succeed exactly as before
4. Setting `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD=false` restores eager builds if they ever need it

## Pre-Submission checklist

- [x] I have added meaningful tests
- [x] The handful of test files covering my change pass locally, e.g. `uv run pytest tests/unit/<your_test_file>.py -v`
- [ ] My PR passes all required CI/CD checks (e.g., lint, schema.d.ts sync check, etc.)
- [x] My PR's scope is as isolated as possible; it only solves 1 specific problem
- [ ] I have received a Greptile **Confidence Score of at least 4/5** before requesting a maintainer review

## Screenshots / Proof of Fix

Shared setup: `litellm/proxy/dev_config.yaml` on port 4000 with a real Anthropic key, same `.venv` for both sides, with `PYTHONPATH=<checkout>:<checkout>/enterprise` so both `litellm` and `litellm_enterprise` come from the checkout under test. Import numbers are warm runs of `import litellm` / `import litellm.proxy.proxy_server` in a fresh interpreter, RSS read from `/proc/self/status`

### Before (65b0557f80)

#### Import cost

1. `import litellm`: 2.16s / 2.20s / 2.29s, RSS 193 MB
2. `import litellm.proxy.proxy_server`: 9.97s / 9.87s, RSS 534 MB
3. LiteLLM pydantic classes with a built schema after proxy import: 1379 of 1423

#### Live proxy

1. `GET /health/liveliness` -> 200
2. `POST /key/generate` with the master key -> key returned for `["anthropic-haiku-4-5"]`
3. `POST /v1/chat/completions` model `anthropic-haiku-4-5`, "Reply with exactly: deferred build ok" -> `deferred build ok`, 22 tokens
4. Same request with `"stream": true` -> 4 SSE `data:` lines ending in `[DONE]`
5. `POST /v1/messages` -> `type: message`, `stop_reason: end_turn`
6. `GET /openapi.json` -> 200, 978 component schemas, 716 paths

### After (3ac44a99f2, plus ccdda7e5cd for the nested-instance fix)

#### Import cost

1. `import litellm`: 1.84s / 1.78s / 1.91s, RSS 172 MB
2. `import litellm.proxy.proxy_server`: 8.82s / 9.04s, RSS 510 MB
3. LiteLLM pydantic classes with a built schema after proxy import: 48 of 1424
4. With `DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD=false`: `import litellm` 2.8s / 196 MB, proxy import 12.2s / 531 MB, confirming the switch

#### Live proxy

1. `GET /health/liveliness` -> 200
2. `POST /key/generate` with the master key -> key returned for `["anthropic-haiku-4-5"]`
3. `POST /v1/chat/completions` model `anthropic-haiku-4-5`, "Reply with exactly: deferred build ok" -> `deferred build ok`, 22 tokens
4. Same request with `"stream": true` -> 4 SSE `data:` lines ending in `[DONE]`
5. `POST /v1/messages` -> `type: message`, `stop_reason: end_turn`
6. `GET /openapi.json` -> 200, JSON identical to Before (978 component schemas, 716 paths)

`tests/unit/types/llms/test_types_llms_base.py` checks in a subprocess that a `LiteLLMBaseModel` subclass stays unbuilt until first use for unset/`true`/`1`/`on`, and builds at class creation for `false`/`0`/`off`, plus that instances created by a parent validator or `model_construct` still serialize as Any. A full `tests/unit` run at the tip compared file by file against main showed no new failing tests (remaining failures are missing optional deps such as `semantic_router`, `vertexai`, `detect_secrets`, identical on main). `make check` passes

## Type

🚄 Infrastructure

## Caveats (if any)

### Low

- Schema errors in a model now surface on first use, not at import
- Docs for the env var are in BerriAI/litellm-docs#2095; the `documentation` and `code-quality` env-key checks read litellm-docs main, so they pass once that PR lands

## Final Attestation

- [x] The tests check the right things, including the edge cases, and regressions in the respective real-world customer use-cases are not possible after this PR

> [!NOTE]
> **Low Risk**
> Performance and import-time behavior change with an env toggle; runtime validation semantics should match once models are used, with schema errors possibly surfacing on first use instead of import.
> 
> **Overview**
> Introduces **`LiteLLMBaseModel`**, a shared Pydantic base that sets **`defer_build`** from the new **`DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD`** env var (defaults to on). The change replaces direct **`BaseModel`** subclasses across **`litellm/`** and **`enterprise/`** with this base so most schemas are built on first use instead of at import—aimed at faster proxy startup and lower import-time memory.
> 
> **`LiteLLMBaseModel.model_post_init`** rebuilds a class when an instance was created via a parent validator or **`model_construct`**, avoiding incomplete serializers on deferred builds. Related cleanups on migrated models use **`Field(default=...)`** for mutable defaults and **`ConfigDict(...)`** where configs were plain dicts.
> 
> Set **`DEFER_PYDANTIC_BUILD=false`** (or **`0`** / **`off`**) to restore eager schema builds at import.
